`./run.sh` now passes: both tests are OK and the exit code is 0.

The bug was in `day_label` in `report.py`. It used `datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)`, which returns the local date. Under `TZ=Pacific/Auckland`, timestamp 1700000000 falls on 2023-11-15 locally, but the docstring and tests expect the UTC date, 2023-11-14. I changed the call to `datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=timezone.utc)` and added the `timezone` import. `daily_counts` uses `day_label`, so it is fixed too.

I did not touch `run.sh` or `test_report.py`.
